mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, weekday trip chaining into shops weakens and retail visitation falls over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying below -15 and TRANSIT staying below -20 for most of the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp weekly drop in PARKS shifts discretionary outings away from outdoor leisure and into indoor retail only after the decline is large enough to signal avoidance behavior, reducing RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after PARKS crosses below -30, or retail rises while PARKS remains below that threshold.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM rises while RETAIL_REC remains depressed, routine essential trips do not spill over into discretionary shopping, so retail stays flat or lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM stays positive and RETAIL_REC does not recover above its recent average.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, a rebound in TRANSIT signals restored access to city-centre retail. When TRANSIT moves up from its recent trough, retail mobility turns higher within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 3 points from its prior weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 28 days after TRANSIT rises by 3 points or more from a depressed level.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in RESIDENTIAL and decrease in TRANSIT indicates substitution toward staying home, which suppresses discretionary retail visits over the next one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 to 14 days when RESIDENTIAL is above its recent mean and TRANSIT is below its recent mean.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upswing in PARKS during winter school-holiday weeks pulls discretionary outings toward non-retail leisure, leaving retail-and-recreation mobility lower over the next month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains above -25 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:decision date is mid-July in Sydney
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though PARKS stays above -25 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both recover together, in-person work trips create lunchtime and after-work shopping spillovers that lift retail mobility within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises and TRANSIT rises in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains at or below its last four-week mean after simultaneous increases in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, a persistent fall in TRANSIT precedes lower retail mobility because access costs rise and destination visits are postponed, with the effect visible after one week and stronger by four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -25 and stays there for at least one week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 to 28 days after TRANSIT drops below -25 and remains weak.
